items.title: Nucor (NUE) Files Shelf Registration To Keep Future Funding Options Open
items.summary: Nucor Corporation (NYSE:NUE) filed an omnibus shelf registration, enabling future issuance of multiple types of securities. The filing allows Nucor to offer debt, common stock, preferred stock, or other securities as needed over time. The shelf structure is designed to give the company flexibility to raise capital efficiently when market conditions align with its plans.
